test_title: PYST 37: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 14 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: Seven people, B, C, D, I, J, K and L, are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre of the table. K sits third to the left of L. I sits to the immediate left of L. D sits to the immediate left of J. J sits second to the left of C. Who sits third to the right of B?
solution:
**Given: **Seven people, B, C, D, I, J, K and L, are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre of the table.

1. I sits to the immediate left of L.

2. K sits third to the left of L.

3. J sits second to the left of C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5816a815a9717b6eb272feea4a21cf62b8252bf8e111c500042d41985212f4fa.png] 

4. D sits to the immediate left of J. 

The above statement cannot be satisfied in case II, so it is eliminated.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/75f929f3bfa85136a1fe6b230a03c5b69078d01246e5a57785c7470c7fc520db.png] 

G, the only person left will occupy the vacant position.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/442095cd931c2fb1abac26b25ab3234f6b474cec87e1c4ed3c0610a4ce640af1.png] 

Thus, K sits third to the right of B.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
